title: feat(ui): an action param's widget draws the named widget, so the action dialog can pick a permission set (#30260)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu9k2t4srZBGSUnXnWt5NrsY)_

Fixes #30260

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/core`'s exported `ActionParamDef` gains one optional member, `widget?: string`, and `@object-ui/fields`' `RawActionParam` gains the same optional member (measured on the built `ui/packages/core/dist/actions/ActionRunner.d.ts` and `ui/packages/fields/dist/resolveActionParams.d.ts`). No accepted key, value or answer is taken away.
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作参数上写的 `widget` 现在真的生效。参数写 `widget: 'permission-ref'` 时，动作对话框画权限集选择器（列出标签与机器名，提交机器名）；未注册的名字退回 `type` 控件。
- 为什么改：spec 半边（#30259）已声明这个键，但控制台没人读，Create User 的权限集只能手敲名字；本卡是读者半边，之后 #30117 的服务端切换才有意义。
- 风险与回滚：只影响写了 `widget` 的参数（或继承字段 widget 的字段型参数）；未写的参数渲染逐字节不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts`（`authoredWidgetKey` 与降级判断）、`ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`（`inheritedWidget`）、`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`（`widget` 行翻 live）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run -t 30260 packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.test.tsx`，预期 3 条通过（选择器提交 `support_agent`、无 widget 的对照是文本框、未注册名退回 textarea）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ActionParamDef.widget`** (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`, the type only): the resolved param carries the spec's `ActionParamSchema.widget`.
- **`resolveActionParam`** (`ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`): copies the param's `widget` on the inline branch and the unresolved-field branch. On the field-backed branch the param's own `widget` wins; otherwise it inherits the field's `FieldSchema.widget`, but only while the param also inherits the field's `type` (or restates it). A param that overrides `type` asks for a different value, so a widget chosen for the field's value is not carried onto it (`inheritedWidget`).
- **`paramToField`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts`): a `widget` that names a registered field widget replaces the `type` widget key the dialog mounts through `getLazyFieldWidget`; a name nothing registers keeps the `type` widget. The test is the shared resolver's own answer (`resolveFormWidgetType`, read for its documented `text` fallback), the same reading the console's `FormPage` makes of a field's `widget`. `paramDegradesWithoutTarget` answers false when a registered widget is drawn, so a targetless lookup param with such a widget gets neither the text fallback nor the paste-an-id hints, and the predicate/adapter equivalence still holds.
- **Spec seam** (comment 6652583019): `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`'s `params.widget` row is `live`, citing both readers, with `authorWarn` / `authorHint` dropped; `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` loses the describe's "Not read yet" sentence, the `//` pointer comment and the JSDoc "Planned" sentence. Generated with them: `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` (`gen:schema && gen:docs`) and `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md` (`gen:liveness-counts`).
- One root changeset (`minor` on `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@objectstack/spec`).

## Why

`ActionParamSchema.widget` was accepted and stored but read by nothing, so a param that asked for the `permission-ref` picker drew a text box. This is the console half of #30117's split; Create User's param switch stays with #30117 (`packages/platform-objects/**` untouched).

## Tests

New pins, each a top-level `describe` in the existing harness file:

- `resolveActionParams.test.ts` — inline copy, field-backed inheritance, restated type inherits, overridden type does not, param beats field, no-widget control, unresolved branch keeps it, the public `ActionParam` type accepts it (8).
- `paramToField.test.ts` — registered widget drawn, no-widget control, unregistered falls back to the param's own type widget (`text` / `select` / `textarea`), an authored `text` honoured, a targetless lookup with a registered widget is drawn and does not degrade, with the unregistered control still degrading (5).
- `ActionParamDialog.test.tsx` — mounted inside `SchemaRendererProvider` with a catalog: the picker lists `Support Agent (support_agent)`, submits `{ permissionSet: 'support_agent' }`, and the emitted value matches `expectedParamShape` (`string`); CONTROL without `widget` is an input that lists nothing; an unregistered name on a `textarea` param is the textarea (3).

## Acceptance notes

- **Bulk dialog not covered.** The selection bar's bulk dialog maps resolved params through plugin-grid's `toBulkParam` / `bulkParamToField`, whose `BulkActionParam` shape has no `widget`, so a promoted bulk action's param still draws its `type` widget. Outside this card's file surface; recorded in the liveness note. carrier: seat.
- **A private copy of the "names a registered widget" test.** `authoredWidgetKey` restates `FormPage`'s `namesRegisteredWidget` (one line over `resolveFormWidgetType`). A shared export would mean editing `@object-ui/fields`' barrel and `ui/apps/console`, both outside the surface. carrier: seat.
- **Field-widget inheritance rule** (a field-backed param inherits the field's `widget` only while it inherits or restates the field's `type`, a restated type matched through the param-type fold; a param that overrides `type` does not) is this PR's reading of the spec's "widget mapping from object metadata"; the seat accepted it at ACCEPT, and the spec JSDoc says the same.
- Contract-review should-fixes (review 6661565862) landed in ae7e6fa4: paramDegradesWithoutTarget judges the widget the param draws, inheritedWidget matches a restated type through the param-type fold, and the spec JSDoc says inherits or restates; 57e88ede turns the lint pin of the planned params.widget warning into its inverse. Delta review PASS 6662404259.
- Branch is the card thread's harness branch `claude/project-thread-ijgrij` (claim amendment 6659791806), not `claude/issue-30260-*`.
- `paramValueShape.ts` needed no edit: `expectedParamShape` resolves through `paramToField`, so a `permission-ref` param already reads its `string` contract row.

## Verification

Ablations (each with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob; the ui suites alias `@object-ui/*` to source, so no build leg):

- `paramToField`: authored widget leg removed ⇒ 5 of the 16 new tests red (the picker render, registered widget drawn, `text` honoured, targetless lookup, public type); controls green.
- `resolveActionParam` inline `widget: param.widget` ⇒ `widget: undefined` ⇒ 2 red.
- field-backed `widget: inheritedWidget(param, field)` deleted ⇒ 3 red.

Local gates on `4d88bf5a` (the head after merging `origin/main`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 105 families, all 105 run, each exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: **105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. Plus the order's extras: `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` exit 0 and `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 (in the derived set). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read built output after a full `turbo run build` (131 packages, exit 0).

Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (the last re-run after the merge), all exit 0. Tests after the merge: `resolveActionParams.test.ts`, `paramToField.test.ts`, `ActionParamDialog.test.tsx`, `paramValueShape.test.ts` exit 0.

Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
